farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:59210c9c-3c.title: Luxury Resale B2B Account Manager (Luxclusif)
farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:59210c9c-3c.description: Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry. The Farfetch Marketplace connects customers in over 190 countries and territories with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands, boutiques, and department stores, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. Luxclusif is a technology-driven global B2B platform founded in 2013 and part of Farfetch since 2021. Dedicated to redefining the luxury paradigm by offering premium pre-owned fashion to a global audience, Luxclusive has pioneered the global luxury resale market, with advanced data-driven solutions to facilitate the buying and selling of high-end pre-owned items. With operations spread across the globe and strategic warehouses in key locations, ensure a seamless supply of luxury goods, ensuring item curation, quality control, operations, logistics to technology integrations and sales, delivering an unmatched resale experience for brands, retailers, and end-customers.
responsibilities: 1. Mid-Term Framework Optimization & Performance Analytics
Establish, optimize, and execute structured, repeatable B2B account playbooks to ensure frictionless onboarding for incoming partners passed down by the New Business Development team.
Monitor and enhance partner operational efficiency, evaluating structured performance metrics and recommending data-driven process improvements.
Conduct regular business reviews with active upfront buying and physical consignment suppliers to advise them on optimizing stock mix, refresh frequencies, and overall partnership health.
2. Cross-Functional Projects & Continuous Improvement
Serve as the core B2B partnership stakeholder in complex, cross-functional business initiatives alongside central global teams (Buying, Operations, Finance, Tech).
Translate macro-industry performance insights into regional growth strategies, unblocking systemic friction before it affects stock inflows or margins.
Provide structured feedback on partners' processes and needs to help internal teams develop scalable solutions for long-term B2B relationship success.
3. Operational Shielding & Escalation Management
Act as the final line of defense for partner retention by directly resolving advanced daily or weekly operational struggles.
Support financial reconciliation bottlenecks, handling disputed credit notes or billing blocks with central Finance team.

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Strategic Transactions Counsel, APEX
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: About Flagship Pioneering Flagship Pioneering invents and builds companies that change the world. We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps in human health, sustainability, and beyond. What sets Flagship apart is our ability to unite life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. Our team of scientists, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and create breakthroughs that generate exceptional value for people and the planet. Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been named four times to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Position Summary Flagship Pioneering is seeking a highly motivated Strategic Transactions Counsel to join our growing Transactions team. Flagship undertakes dozens of complex and value-oriented transactions at any given time, including complex joint ventures and partnerships, licensing and collaborations, mergers and acquisition, initial public offerings, global fundraising as well as and business and corporate development initiatives. All of the activities associated with transactions at Flagship are led by a cross-disciplinary group, referred to internally as the “APEX Group”. APEX is an acronym for “Acquisitions, Partnership, Equity and eXecution.” This is an outstanding opportunity for an experienced life sciences attorney who wants exposure to some of the most innovative companies and partnerships involved in ground-breaking transactions. The ideal candidate will have approximately 5+ years of law firm and/or in-house experience. Rather than serving solely as a legal specialist, this role will sit at the intersection of business, law, strategy, finance, and transactions. This individual will partner closely with other business leaders in working on transactions, including members of Flagship’s Executive Leadership Team, Business Development, IP, Corporate Development, senior management of portfolio companies and other leadership teams to help execute a wide range of strategic transactions across the Flagship ecosystem. Responsibilities Own and drive, together with other members of the APEX Group, the execution of transactions across the Flagship ecosystem, including licensing, collaboration, partnership, joint venture, M&A, and other strategic transactions as well as equity investments, recapitalizations, and other capital accessing activities Coordinate with other colleagues at Flagship and external advisors to facilitate great decision-making. Drive the structuring of complex transactions to achieve strategic and financial objectives. Drive the negotiation of transaction terms and the completion of relevant processes. Help standardize transaction processes, playbooks, templates, and best practices across the organization. Manage multiple transactions simultaneously in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Stay ahead of industry trends, evolving regulations, and legal developments impacting pharmaceutical collaborations and biotech transactions. Proactively engage and direct external law firm partners and advisors to manage high-stakes negotiations and complex deal structures and legal cost associated with the same. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:b87e8700-b77.title: Digital & Field Events Marketing Manager
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:b87e8700-b77.description: Wing is seeking elite talent to join M32 AI (backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs), dedicated to building agentic AI for traditional service businesses. Think of it like a startup within a corporate: fast moving and agile, with the stability of a corporate, and zero bureaucracy. If you’re driven by challenge and eager to make a significant impact in a high-caliber role, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. We're hiring a Field & Events Marketer to own our presence at industry events, tradeshows, and conferences across North America. You'll source the right shows, run them end to end, and be the person on the ground making sure every event drives real pipeline. This is a hands-on role for someone 1-4 years into their career who loves logistics, thrives in fast-paced environments, and gets a kick out of pulling off a great event. You'll partner closely with sales, marketing, and product to turn booth space and badge scans into meetings, opportunities, and closed revenue. Why This Role You'll own a high-visibility function from day one. Every event is a chance to shape how customers, prospects, and the industry see us. If you want to grow fast, take real ownership, and build a portfolio of events you're genuinely proud of, this is the seat for you.
responsibilities: Source and prioritize events. Research, evaluate, and recommend tradeshows, conferences, and industry events that align with our ICP and revenue goals. Own a rolling 12-month event calendar.
Negotiate and contract. Manage relationships with event organizers, vendors, and venues. Negotiate sponsorships, booth space, speaking slots, and add-ons to stretch every dollar.
Plan and execute end to end. Own every detail, including booth design and shipping, swag, collateral, lead capture, badge scanners, AV, catering, hotel blocks, and travel logistics for the team.
Be the on-site point of contact. Attend every event in person. Set up and tear down booths, troubleshoot in real time, and make sure our presence looks sharp from start to finish.
Prep the team. Brief attending team members on objectives, talking points, target accounts, and logistics. Make sure everyone knows where to be, when, and what to do.
Drive pipeline with sales. Partner with sales to book pre-show meetings, run dinners and customer events on-site, and ensure every lead is captured, qualified, and followed up on quickly.
Run pre- and post-event campaigns. Work with marketing on email outreach, landing pages, paid promotion, and social to drive booth traffic and meeting bookings before the show.
Own the budget. Manage event spend across the full calendar. Track costs, forecast accurately, flag risks early, and make smart trade-off decisions when priorities shift.
Define KPIs and report on results. Set clear KPIs for each event (leads, meetings, pipeline, ROI) and build clean post-event reports that show what worked, what didn't, and how to improve next time.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:918766e5-9b53-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. This is a senior engineering opportunity focused on building the foundational platform layer behind secure, production-grade AI applications. You will design shared infrastructure, services, integrations, and developer tooling that enable teams to build and scale AI capabilities efficiently. The role combines hands-on work with LLMs, AI agents, RAG, tool calling, and AI workflows with strong data engineering and platform engineering practices. You will leverage modern cloud and data technologies to turn experimental AI use cases into reliable, scalable production systems. Working across Engineering, Product, and IT, you will establish technical patterns, reusable capabilities, and governance standards for AI development. This fully remote role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving foundational problems and shaping how AI is built and operated across an organization. Design and build reusable platform capabilities supporting LLM applications, AI agents, RAG, tool calling, and AI workflows. Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, infrastructure technologies, and development approaches to determine their potential business value. Promote strong data engineering and platform practices around data modeling, data quality, secure data access, and operational reliability. Strong data engineering fundamentals, including data pipelines, data modeling, data quality, and secure data access. jobgether-jobgether:lever:bee1e65c-ca6e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Product Manager – Time to First Production based in Italy. This is a high-impact product leadership role focused on improving the journey from a customer’s first interaction with the platform to successfully running their first process in production. You will own a company-wide product outcome, defining the north-star metrics, customer journey, strategy, and roadmap that guide major investments. Working across Product, Engineering, Design, Experience, Data, Marketing, and GTM, you will turn customer evidence into clear priorities and measurable outcomes. The role sits at the intersection of AI-assisted product development, agentic experiences, guided onboarding, testing, validation, and production readiness. You will have significant autonomy to shape an evolving product area and establish the measurement framework that demonstrates progress. Success will depend on your ability to influence senior stakeholders, create alignment without formal authority, and translate complex opportunities into focused execution. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced product leader who wants visible impact and the chance to help shape an AI-first product organization. Own the Time to First Production outcome end to end, defining its north-star metrics, customer journey, strategic objectives, roadmap, and key initiatives. Establish a clear vision for what an exceptional first-production experience looks like and translate that vision into measurable product outcomes. Partner with data and validation teams to create robust, end-to-end measurement of the customer journey, identifying gaps and opportunities for improvement. Set priorities across initiatives covering AI-assisted and agentic building experiences, onboarding, guided development, testing and validation, production readiness, and human-in-the-loop process experiences. Work closely with Engineering, Design, and Experience leaders to translate strategy into execution and ensure investments remain aligned with customer outcomes. Represent the outcome area to senior leadership, Product Marketing, and go-to-market teams, communicating progress, priorities, insights, and strategic recommendations through clear, evidence-based narratives. Collaborate with other product outcome leaders to maintain a coherent overall product strategy and ensure smooth transitions between customer lifecycle stages. Bring an outside-in perspective to roadmap decisions by continuously incorporating customer research, feedback, behavioral data, and market evidence. Influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders without relying on direct reporting authority, creating alignment around strategy and measurable outcomes. Continuously refine the product strategy as customer needs, AI capabilities, market conditions, and organizational priorities evolve. Help shape an AI-first product operating model by exploring new ways AI agents and intelligent tooling can support product development, process creation, testing, and optimization. Requirements: Significant experience as a Principal, Staff, or similarly senior Product Manager , owning a cross-functional, metrics-driven product outcome, platform, or strategic area rather than a single feature. Strong background in B2B or enterprise SaaS , with experience managing products or experiences that span multiple teams, workflows, or customer lifecycle stages. Demonstrated ability to establish north-star metrics and measurement frameworks from the ground up, working effectively with data and analytics teams to create credible and actionable insights. Proven ability to develop product strategy and roadmaps based on customer evidence, quantitative data, market signals, and business priorities. Your job is to oversee our entire incubation engine, lead cross-company execution, and manage capital allocation with surgical precision. This is a remote, high-availability role for a battle-tested leader who views company building as an elite science and thrives at the absolute forefront of the Web3 economy. We value execution, velocity, and high-impact judgment. Whether you are a multi-time founder who has successfully scaled ecosystems or an elite operations executive from a high-growth tech platform, we care about your ability to lead. If you have the analytical rigor to allocate capital effectively across multiple fast-moving targets and the strategic vision to steer a portfolio through volatile market cycles, we will give you the resources and authority to direct our entire venture pipeline. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Studio Operations: Own the overarching operational blueprint of the Venture Studio, ensuring our internal processes, workflows, and communication loops run with elite efficiency. - Venture Oversight: Supervise active incubator projects from raw ideation to independent launch, keeping portfolio founders metrics-driven and aligned with global standards. - Team Leadership: Inspire, mentor, and align a decentralized team of shared specialists, including legal, compliance, design, marketing, and engineering resources. - Capital Allocation: Manage the studio budget and deployment pipelines with cold, calculated efficiency, determining exactly where to double down and where to conserve resources. - Strategic Planning: Architect the long-term vision and macro-strategy of the studio, identifying emerging market sectors and structural shifts before they break mainstream. - Cross-Company Execution: Serve as the ultimate connective tissue across our portfolio companies, ensuring technical roadmaps, marketing launches, and operational handovers are flawlessly synchronized. skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:76983c2c-36bc-44de.title: First Product Manager - Risora
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:76983c2c-36bc-44de.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми в пошуку Product Manager у новий бізнес 90% людей не досягають цілей, які ставлять на початку року. Не тому що ледачі — а тому що не знають себе достатньо, щоб діяти відповідно до своїх сильних сторін. Ми будуємо AI-powered мобільний застосунок, який змінює підхід до саморозвитку через персоналізовані симуляції та гейміфікацію. Duolingo навчив мільйони людей мов через 5 хвилин на день. Ми хочемо зробити те саме з розумінням себе — для tier-one ринків США, Великої Британії, ЄС, Австралії та Канади. Ти приєднуєшся як перший Product Manager з перспективою вирости у CPO та ко-фаундера. Які виклики чекають: — Робота над продуктовим роадмапом; — Вести стратегію і запуск мобільного застосунку на tier-one ринках; — Проводити user research, інтерв'ю та usability-тести, щоб валідувати продуктові рішення; — Визначати і трекати ключові продуктові метрики — retention, activation, engagement, conversion; — Співпрацювати з дизайном, щоб створювати інтуїтивний, гейміфікований UX; — Щодня використовувати AI-інструменти, щоб прискорювати research, прототипування та execution; — Заглиблюватись у психологію особистості та психотипи, щоб точніше діджиталізувати людський досвід. Що для нас важливо: — 4+ роки досвіду в продакт-менеджменті, рівень Senior; — Підтверджений досвід ведення мобільного застосунку (iOS/Android) на tier-one ринках; — Data-first підхід — сильні навички аналізу даних для побудови правильного user flow — Досвід роботи з аналітичними інструментами: Amplitude, Mixpanel або Firebase; — Високий рівень AI-флюентності — ти використовуєш AI-інструменти, щоб писати, досліджувати, прототипувати і будувати, а не просто щоб чатитись; — Підтверджений трек-рекорд вимірюваних результатів на попередніх ролях Що для нас бажано: — Інтерес або бекграунд у психології особистості, психотипах або behavioral science; — Досвід з AI-powered та гейміфікованими consumer-продуктами; — Досвід у 0-to-1 стартап-середовищі. У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: — SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. — Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. — Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо. — Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech? Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI. By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms. Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation. What You’ll Need - Native or near-native fluency in Arabic - Based in: Egypt, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Jordan, Morocco, Sudan, Iraq, Somalia, Tunisia, Libya, Lebanon, Mauritania, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain, Qatar - English proficiency - Comfortable with digital tools - Detail-oriented and curious Why Join Us? 🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow 🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI 🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community About our projects: Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.
